author: ojiudezue
title: 'Mini room' = trim the room menu by room type, not a new entry kind
summary: Room type decides which options steps show (closet/hallway ~5, bathroom/garage/infrastructure 7, living spaces 12); every type shows Lighting; Climate & Fans also for bathroom and infrastructure. Menu-only: hidden steps keep values and keep working; any step with non-default values always shows; 'More settings…' opens the full menu for that visit. Plan written, in plan review; operator will decide after seeing the dialog cleanup (morning 2026-09-30) — may move quickly.
why: A separate 'mini room' entry kind would be a second setup path with migrations on kind change; room type already exists and already drives defaults, so attenuating by type is cheap and behaviour-neutral. The load-bearing risk is the 'in use' check hiding a configured step.
implications: Keep PLANNING_room_type_trimmed_menu.md in view as the next UX build after the lighting slices. Covers row still open (plan: all but utility/infrastructure).
revisit_trigger: Operator's reaction to the v5.103.26 dialogs in the morning; any configured step found hidden.
